gloss: a little while ago; a bit earlier; just before

definitions.gloss: a little while ago; a bit earlier; just before
definitions.explanation: Refers to a short time before the present or before some specified moment. Can describe minutes, hours, days, or weeks earlier depending on context.

examples.japanese: {少|すこ}し{前|まえ}に{帰|かえ}ったよ。
examples.english: He went home a little while ago.

examples.japanese: {少|すこ}し{前|まえ}まで{彼女|かのじょ}とは{連絡|れんらく}を{取|と}っていた。
examples.english: Until a little while ago, I was in touch with her.

examples.japanese: {少|すこ}し{前|まえ}にこの{辺|へん}で{大|おお}きな{事故|じこ}があったらしい。
examples.english: Apparently there was a big accident around here a little while ago.

notes:
Compound of {少|すこ}し (a little) + {前|まえ} (before, ago). The amount of time is left vague — context determines whether "a little" means minutes or months.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {少|すこ}し{前|まえ}に: a little while ago (most common)
- {少|すこ}し{前|まえ}まで: until a little while ago
- ほんの{少|すこ}し{前|まえ}: just a moment ago (emphasized)
- {少|すこ}し{前|まえ}の{話|はなし}: a recent story

SIMILAR WORDS:
- さっき: a little while ago — casual, usually means very recently (minutes)
- {先程|さきほど}: a moment ago (polite) — formal equivalent of さっき
- ちょっと{前|まえ}: a bit ago — synonymous and interchangeable
- この{間|あいだ}: the other day — usually days or weeks ago
